solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Thought this might suggest enslavement?

definitions.meaning: read as DE- plus LIBERATION, the word suggests the undoing of freedom, which is enslavement

explanation.surface: A wry musing on whether a word for thinking could hint at slavery.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is playful: the prefix DE- reverses things, so de-liberation would mean taking freedom away.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: long careful consideration of something is thought about it.

clue.text: Daughter, tot with yen for father

parts.note: to tot up is to add
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A daughter and a toddler bring some Japanese money to their dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tot' looks like a small child but is the verb to add up.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an informal, childish word for a parent who is male.

clue.text: Bed time? Possibly it's ghoul time!

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Is bedtime really the hour when ghouls come out?
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the call for lamps to be switched off marks the hour when people go to sleep.

clue.text: Labour Party's involvement with EU — a new face being put on here?

definitions.text: a new face being put on here?

indicators.note: the letters of the two names are entangled together and rearranged

explanation.surface: A political jibe: the Labour Party's dealings with Europe are a mere cosmetic makeover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involvement with' tangles the letters of LABOUR PARTY and EU; the 's is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic hint: a salon where make-up and treatments give a customer a fresh look.

clue.text: Soldiers wanting chief to hang on

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
chief means main, principal

explanation.surface: Troops want their commander to hold out a little longer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to stay put or stick around is to hang on.

clue.text: Like a delta in which a number will get trapped

parts.note: three is a number
cornered means trapped with no way out

explanation.surface: A river mouth where some figure or count will end up stuck.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the Greek capital delta is a triangle, a shape with three angles.

clue.text: Work not beginning — fuel needed

indicators.note: the word for work loses its first letter

parts.note: toil means hard work

explanation.surface: If the job can't get started, some fuel is required.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: petroleum and similar liquids are burned as fuel.

clue.text: Sailor meets girl, a divine being

parts.note: OS is an ordinary seaman
Iris is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A seaman encounters a young woman who turns out to be a goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an Egyptian god of the dead and the underworld.

clue.text: Trouble with graduate's blind faith?

parts.note: to dog someone is to trouble or pursue them
MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate

explanation.surface: A graduate's troubles stem from unquestioning belief.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym-ish: a creed accepted without question is held with blind faith.

clue.text: One would become crazy losing this game

definitions.text: One would become crazy losing this game

parts.words: One would become crazy losing this game
parts.note: to lose these is an idiom for going mad, and they are also a children's game

explanation.surface: A sore loser goes mad after defeat at a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom plus example: small glass balls used in a playground game, and also one's wits.

clue.text: Monstrous creature — one not spotted nevertheless

indicators.note: the numeral is absent, as if never seen, from the creature

parts.note: the yeti is the abominable snowman of the Himalayas
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A monster that has still never been sighted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not spotted' fits the elusive yeti, but here it removes I.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: both mean in spite of that, still or however.

clue.text: Bats aren't idle — this bat may not stay around for long

definitions.text: this bat may not stay around for long

indicators.note: bats means crazy, so the letters go wild and rearrange

explanation.surface: A cricket line: the bats are busy, but one batsman will soon be out.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a bat is also a batsman, and the weakest batsmen go in last.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket term: a low-order player, picked for bowling, who rarely lasts long at the crease.

clue.text: Girl's church book found in the sack

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so Di's
a missal is a prayer book used at Mass

explanation.surface: A girl's prayer book turns up in a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the sack' looks like a bag but means being fired.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: getting the sack is being fired from a job.

clue.text: Vessel taking supplies west

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading right to left

parts.note: pools are shared supplies or reserves

explanation.surface: A ship carrying provisions heads westward.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small single-masted sailing ship.

clue.text: A deception — initially, husband's upset woman

parts.note: the 's supplies an S

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of husband
upset means knocked over, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: a lie is a deception

explanation.surface: A woman is distressed by her husband's lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' scrambles LIE, H (the first letter of husband) and the S from 's into SHEIL; the clue's A goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian slang: a young woman or girl.

clue.text: Love obtained by a little girl in haven

indicators.note: the love letter is gained by what follows, so it comes first

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O
sis, short for sister, is a little girl

explanation.surface: A child finds love in a safe place.
explanation.definitionFit: Metaphor: a fertile spot in a desert, hence any refuge or place of calm.

clue.text: Sacred utterance from fellow on train leaving home

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: home's word departs from the train

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A man on a train away from home chants a prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a word or phrase repeated in meditation, as in Hindu or Buddhist practice.

clue.text: Internet — a strange delight

indicators.note: strange signals letters in an odd order

explanation.surface: The web is a curious source of pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to amuse or charm someone is to delight them.

clue.text: Troublemaker in grim place

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the words grim place

explanation.surface: A mischief-maker lurks in a grim spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a little devil or mischievous child is a troublemaker.

clue.text: Called after parking incident damaging car?

indicators.note: after places the word for called after the parking letter

parts.note: P is the map and road sign symbol for parking
rang means telephoned, called

explanation.surface: Someone phoned after an accident in the car park.
explanation.walkthrough: PRANG is British slang for a minor car crash.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: a minor collision that dents a vehicle.

clue.text: Attack devil finally with a yell

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of devil

parts.note: a yell is a shout

explanation.surface: A devil finishes its assault with a scream.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: to strike out violently or verbally at someone.

clue.text: Evil in Jerusalem with love denied

indicators.note: love is refused a place in the name of the city

parts.note: Sion, or Zion, is the hill of Jerusalem and a name for the city
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: Wickedness in the holy city where love is withheld.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wrongdoing or wickedness, a moral offence.

clue.text: Artist crossing a street — someone with distinctive hairstyle?

indicators.note: the artist and the a span across the street on both sides

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter crosses the road; someone with striking hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Rastafarian, often recognisable by dreadlocks.

clue.text: Two members providing a lot of money

definitions.meaning: limbs are members, and these are a pair of limbs
the idiom for a huge price, as in it cost the earth

explanation.surface: A pair of limbs worth a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something costing a fortune costs this; literally two limbs.
